knowledge_documents.title: General Clinic Info
knowledge_documents.content: Our clinic is located at 123 Main Street. We accept cash and card as payment methods. If you need to cancel or reschedule an appointment, please give us at least 24 hours notice. If you are experiencing a dental emergency, please call the front desk directly rather than using this chat.
